title: The Sending of the Twelve
description: Jesus gathers the twelve together and gives them power and authority over evil spirits and to heal diseases. He sends them out to preach the kingdom of God, instructing them to travel without a staff, bag, bread, money, or extra tunic. They are to stay in the house that welcomes them, and shake the dust off their feet against those who reject them. The disciples go out and travel from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.
